public_input: Full original requirement, public I/O interface and all supplied input/output test cases. No reference code, internal-variable skeleton, or formal properties.
independent_judge: Fresh compile/runtime execution of delivered code before publishing task history; no model calls; separate tool cost.
unknown_handling: One retry of the same code; unknown/error remains incomplete, never pass.
no_feedback_visibility: Independent complete generation from empty code; no current-task diagnostics or feedback-derived strategy. NoFeedback may learn after task completion for subsequent tasks.
budget: 10 candidates and 64 total calls including generation/reflection/curation/review, same 2M token and 24h caps; early stop on success.
interpretation: Exploratory within-stream adaptation on longest tasks selected from historical training pool; not an unseen holdout or independent-task causal test.
after_completion: Audit, report, notify, stop. No successor.

output_adapter.selection: Exactly one complete JSON document, including unfenced prose, or one complete ST program; reject malformed/competing candidates.
output_adapter.auxiliary_fields: Preserve raw metadata; bound display only; absent/invalid metadata explicitly unavailable.
output_adapter.learning: Recover one JSON object; leave claim/review evidence validation unchanged.
output_adapter.usage: Preserve native usage; normalization never generates a second model request.

sampling.seed_strategy: No native model seed; task order seed remains 20260914.
sampling.source: Native Anthropic-compatible request: temperature only; not identical stochastic controls to Qwen.

prior_results: Fresh four streams and empty knowledge. No v1/v2 results or knowledge imported or overwritten.
comparison_limit: Separate output protocol from Haiku v1/v2. Do not merge scores; historical task exposure remains.
